svg.title: Fair exchange with an adaptor signature
svg.desc: Alice pays Bob for a secret. Bob holds the witness of the statement and sends the statement to Alice. Alice pre-signs the payment message for that statement with her signing key and sends the pre-signature to Bob. Bob pre-verifies it, adapts it with his witness, and publishes the resulting ordinary signature on the ledger. Alice reads that signature off the ledger and extracts the witness from it and the pre-signature she kept.
svg.text: Fair exchange with an adaptor signature
